ideas.why: Having no JSON-LD is explicitly not a required fix.

ideas.idea: Expand thin page content: list all varieties with headings and attributes, each linked to its own page
ideas.why: The varieties page claims over forty but names only two, so listing them gives readers and machines real content.

ideas.idea: Add address, directions, exact hours and contact details as plain text on the visit page
ideas.why: The visit page has only a vague season and days, so concrete details help users and answer engines.

ideas.idea: Home page should state what is sold, how to buy, delivery areas and prices
ideas.why: It is a content suggestion that assumes things the repo doesn't show, such as a shop with delivery and prices.

ideas.idea: Add Google-Extended, CCBot, Applebot-Extended, anthropic-ai, Meta-ExternalAgent and Bytespider to the robots.txt block
ideas.why: geo.config.json says trainingCrawlers: block but robots.txt only blocks GPTBot and ClaudeBot.

ideas.idea: Name search/retrieval agents explicitly in robots.txt
ideas.why: They are already allowed under the wildcard, so naming them only makes the intent clearer.

ideas.idea: Add title template, default description, openGraph and twitter metadata in layout
ideas.why: This is standard metadata advice, and each page already sets its own title and description.
This applies to almost any site and has little effect on discoverability.

ideas.idea: Lengthen meta descriptions to 120–160 characters with keywords
ideas.why: This is character-count folklore, though the visit description is short.

ideas.idea: Generate the sitemap with app/sitemap.ts and lastModified
ideas.why: The three-page sitemap is accurate, so this only helps maintenance and freshness signals.

ideas.idea: Resolve the robots.txt Disallow combined with noindex on /account, and prefer removing the Disallow
ideas.why: The /account noindex and disallow is a deliberate choice that is correct for a private page.

ideas.idea: Use next/link instead of plain anchors in the nav
ideas.why: The report itself says this affects performance, not discoverability.
Having no llms.txt is not a problem, and it doesn't help sites get found.

ideas.idea: Generate robots.txt from geo.config.json or add a drift check
ideas.why: Nothing reads geo.config.json, and it already disagrees with robots.txt.
